name: Elizabeth Criscitello
bio: Married Tim Criscitello in 2019. Tim's older brother is Colby Criscitello. Graduated SUNY Potsdam 2022 with a BA in English. Barista at Park Bros from 2017. Lives in Potsdam with Tim and their two daughters. Was in Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (2017) at CFA — the production where JD first noticed Bronwyn Paladin.
public_footprint:
Elizabeth Criscitello of Potsdam, NY, graduated from SUNY Potsdam (Class of 2023) with dual degrees in English writing and community health; she was named a 2022 English and Communications Departmental Scholar and made the President's List multiple times. SUNY Potsdam's 'Motherhood and Education' feature profiles her balancing motherhood with her studies.
Sources: https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/Elizabeth-Criscitello-Named-English-and-Communications-Departmental-Scholar-at-SUNY-Potsdam/83177146; https://www.potsdam.edu/academics/AAS/depts/engl/EllieCriscitello
